name: landing-03-how
prompt: Show another screen of this same landing page further down. Keep the identical thin top navigation bar (the S logo and "Smart-Clearance", the links, "Sign in" and the green "Book a demo" button) and the same visual system, fonts and miniature-diorama photography. Replace everything below the navigation; the hero, its headline and the giant carton must not appear. Below the navigation, on the pale sage-white ground: 1) A left-aligned heading in the same heavy dark display type, "Nine stops. Ten agents. One yes.", with one line beneath: "The agents do the running around. A person approves once, with the money on screen." 2) The left half is one large rounded image: a tilt-shift miniature diorama of a small Indian town square at golden hour where one giant round amber push button, as big as a house, sits on the ground; a tiny woman in a sari stands beside it holding a phone; tiny trucks and a van wait at the edges of the square with their engines off. 3) The right half is a vertical tracker list: nine small circles joined by a thin vertical line, each with a bold stop name and a short grey line: "Connect · the distributor's stock export and one permission", "Detect · the Watcher checks shelf life at 09:00", "Verify · Vision reads the label photo", "Value · five exits priced, the bin included", "Decide · the Router splits the batch", "Approve · one tap, with the money on screen", "Execute · listing, offers in Hindi, negotiation, pickup", "Settle · invoice, e-way bill, credit note, GST memo", "Report · a BRSR line after the return window". The circles are green, except the "Approve" circle, which is amber and slightly larger. Miniature diorama photography for the town square; crisp flat interface for the navigation, text and tracker; all text legible.
postprocess: WebP; the PNG original stays local in .impeccable/mocks/
use: SC-25 design board: Section 'Nine stops. Ten agents. One yes.': a giant amber push button in a miniature town square with a woman in a sari beside it, next to a vertical list of the nine stops, with Approve marked in amber.
